artworks.title: A Captain of Banditti
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight being directed by a figure in elaborate costume. The scene shows a person in elaborate clothing gesturing toward the horizon while another figure in armor and carrying a sword appears to take action. The two figures are in a rocky landscape with a cloudy sky overhead. The detailed line work shows intricate patterns on their clothing. The composition emphasizes a moment of decision or command. In the background, there is a fence and trees, suggesting an outdoor setting. The cross-hatching technique adds depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: Richard II
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length depiction of a person in a three-quarter view to the left. The individual is in a regal or authoritative pose, with their head slightly turned. Their features are detailed, with strong facial features, a prominent nose and lips, and a beard. They are wearing an elaborate turban or headdress with a central jewel or brooch, suggesting nobility. Their clothing is richly embroidered, and they have large earrings. Behind them, another figure appears to be floating, holding an object above the main figure's head. The background has a textured, stippled pattern in an oval frame. The text "RICHARD, II" is inscribed above the figure, identifying them.

artworks.title: Sleeping Monsters
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of fantastical creatures sleeping by the water. The drawing depicts a cluster of monstrous beings resting at the edge of a body of water. The creatures have a hybrid appearance with features resembling both humans and animals, including horns and scales. The detailed line work captures the texture of their skin and the ripples in the water. The surrounding landscape includes water, grass, and skeletal remains on the ground.

artworks.title: Revengeful Monsters
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 16.8 × 23.2 cm (6 5/8 × 9 1/8 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical sea creatures in conflict. The image depicts multiple fantastical creatures with human-like torsos and fish-like tails rising from the waves, engaged in a struggle. On the left, a figure with a goat-like head and horns appears to be battling using a serpentine weapon. To the right, another character holds a sea monster with force. The detailed linework highlights dramatic faces and forms of the creatures, creating a sense of movement and turmoil. The background hints at a turbulent sea setting, emphasizing the chaotic energy of the scene.

artworks.title: Banditti Taking His Post
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of armed guards with spears in a rocky landscape. The composition shows a rocky terrain with vegetation. A figure in classical armor and helmet is seated on a rock, with a spear nearby and gesturing with an outstretched arm. Two other figures are crouched under a rocky outcrop. The background has trees and clouds. The artwork features detailed textures in armor, clothing, and rocks, creating a dramatic narrative. The style includes fine lines, intricate details, and dynamic forms for storytelling.

artworks.title: Banditti Taking His Post
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals positioned within a rocky, natural setting. The central figure is seated, facing left and extending an arm towards the other two individuals below him. He wears a helmet, sleeveless vest, knee-length shorts, and sandals. His hair is partly visible under the helmet. The other two individuals crouch beside a rock, one wearing a turban. In the foreground, there are rocks and sparse vegetation, with a spear and jug to the right. The background shows a distant landscape with clouds and tree branches.

artworks.title: Beatrice
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a person from the shoulders up. The individual is depicted in a seated or standing position facing to the right, with their head slightly turned to reveal their side profile. The person has a pronounced nose, well-defined eyes, and full lips. Their hair is styled with curls cascading down and adorned with a headpiece or crown that includes beads and a feather element. They wear an elegant gown with lace detailing. There is no visible jewelry or objects held. The background is a textured shading within an oval shape, framed by a rectangular border with a decorative pattern.

artworks.title: Enrag'd Monster
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological creature labeled as an "ENRAG'D MONSTER." The image depicts a beast with a human-like upper body and a serpentine lower body emerging from water. The creature has an intense expression, wild hair, and a muscular form. Its tail is curled aggressively, surrounded by splashes and aquatic movement. The background shows a turbulent sky with swirling clouds, adding to the dynamic atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Miller of Trompington and Two Scholars
artworks.artist: William Sharp, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows three men and part of a horse in an outdoor setting near a building. The men are engaged in conversation, wearing similar attire with caps on their heads. A fourth person, likely a female, leans out of a window in the building. A horse is visible on the right, with a mounted bird on the wall above. The background features a wooden structure with windows, and the image has a framed appearance.

artworks.title: Boat in a Storm at Sea
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a small sailing vessel in rough seas. The horizon divides the turbulent waves from the sky with a few clouds. The style resembles an engraving with detailed linework showing the texture of the waves and billowing sails. People on the boat are actively managing against the waves. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes contrast and a timeless quality. In the distance, other ships can be seen, highlighting the vastness of the sea.

artworks.title: Silenus
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body and head in a side angle as he looks over his shoulder. He has a hooked nose, bushy eyebrows, curly short hair with a grapevine wreath, and a grinning expression with visible wrinkles and a textured beard. He wears a loose garment and the background is dark with an oval border around the portrait. The name "Silenus" is written at the bottom along with artist details.

artworks.title: Going Out in the Morning
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing side by side. The person on the left is positioned with their arm raised, pointing forward, while supporting a large spear with their right hand. They have a helmet covering their head, long hair, and wear a robe and sandals. The person on the right stands closely, leaning toward the first person with their arm around the other's shoulder, holding a flagpole. They have a beard, curly hair, and wear a shirt, trousers, and a bag slung over one shoulder, barefoot. The background displays a landscape with shrubbery, trees, and distant figures wielding spears, against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Killing an Enemy
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a dramatic pose. One figure stands with a sword, while the other figure is kneeling. Both have curly hair, wearing draped garments. The background includes spear tips and abstract foliage shapes under a cloudy sky. The drawing is detailed with etched lines for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Stripping the Slain
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a soldier removing armor from a fallen opponent in a forested landscape. The fallen figure has a peaceful expression while the soldier is focused on the task. The background features dense line work creating a textured forest setting with swirling clouds or smoke. The artist used hatching and cross-hatching for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Retiring Wounded from Battle
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image features a male figure leaning against a large rock, dressed in historical attire with a piece of leg armor on one leg, bare feet, and a draped garment. He has one hand on the rock for support, with a helmet placed next to him. In the background, there are soldiers in armor in a wooded area with trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Conversing with a Captive
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures. On the left, a person is partially reclining against a stone-like structure, with a sword resting at their side and their right arm resting on their thigh. This individual is looking towards the viewer, with curly, short hair visible. They wear loosely draped clothing that gathers in folds around the waist and legs. On the right, another person stands, positioned with one leg bent and slightly forward. They are holding a spear upright in their left hand and have their right hand on the brim of a helmet, which partially obscures their face. Their hair is long and flowing, visible under the helmet. This individual also wears draping attire that clings to the form. In the background, there are several figures, some with turbans, gathered around or leaning against architectural ruins. Billowing clouds fill the sky above the scene.

artworks.title: Enjoying Domestic Happiness
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures in an interior scene with various objects surrounding them. The main figure is a woman seated in the center, appearing relaxed with her head resting on her hand. She has mid-length hair tied back and is wearing a light, flowing dress or robe with loose sleeves. On either side of her are two more figures. To her left, a man is standing leaning on a staff. To her right, a young girl stands slightly behind the seated woman with curly hair and a cap. A young child is seated at the woman's feet with arms extended upward. Several household items are also present, including a jug, a cabinet, and baskets. A sword and helmet hang on the wall above them. The background features rough walls and wooden beams, creating a rustic indoor setting.

artworks.title: Two Soldiers and Child Holding a Helmet
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows three figures - two adults and a child. The central figure is a seated woman leaning against a large, cracked stone structure. She wears layered garments and her hair is wrapped in a cloth. Beside her is a man in armor with a helmet, holding a spear or staff. A child is seated on the ground playing with a jug. The background displays large fluffy clouds, vegetation on the stone structure, and a natural landscape.

artworks.title: Banditti: Three Heads
artworks.artist: Joseph Haynes, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of three male figures, each showing their shoulders and heads within a circular frame. The person on the right has sharp facial features, a mustache, and a cap or turban with feather-like details. The central figure has textured, curly hair and appears youthful. The third person on the left wears a distinctive turban. The figures wear layered, draping fabrics. The central figure rests his chin on the hilt of a large, engraved sword. The background is a densely textured pattern.

artworks.title: Pilgrims
artworks.artist: Joseph Haynes, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration with two male figures depicted in a side profile, cut off at the chest. The foremost figure has curly hair, distinct facial features including a strong nose and prominent chin, and wears a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a feather and draped fabric. He is dressed in a loose-fitting shirt with visible folds, suggesting a somewhat rustic attire. This figure is holding a staff or stick in his left hand, which is visible in the foreground. The second figure, positioned slightly behind, has a bushy beard and also features curly hair, wearing a similarly adorned hat. The background is plain, focusing attention on the figures enclosed within an oval frame.

artworks.title: James Smithson and Alice Whitworth
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows profile views of two individuals. On the left is a man named James Smithson and on the right is a woman named Alice Whitworth. James Smithson is depicted wearing a hat with a feather detail, a ruffled collar, and has distinctive facial features with a prominent nose and curly beard. Alice Whitworth is wearing a headdress with a patterned band, has sharply defined facial features, and is shown with a ruffled collar and an earring. The background is neutral.

artworks.title: Man Attacking a Monster
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a human figure battling a creature in a rocky landscape. The figure is depicted engaging with a serpent-like dragon, coiled around them. The figure holds a dagger and appears prepared to strike the creature. The drawing shows detailed lines and shading, creating depth in both the background and the figures. The style is reminiscent of classical mythological themes seen in engravings from the late Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Bearded Man with Turban and Young Woman
artworks.artist: Robert Blyth, after John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of two figures positioned back-to-back. The main figure is an older man with a prominent profile, featuring a strong nose, a beard, and weathered facial features. He wears a large turban adorned with a tall feather plume and richly detailed clothing. Partially visible behind him is a second figure, a young person with eyes closed and head slightly tilted, also wearing a turban with feathers. The background is textured with a circular area, and the scene is rendered in monochrome style, surrounded by a plain border with text at the bottom detailing a dedication.

artworks.title: Ophelia
artworks.artist: John Hamilton Mortimer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image features a detailed portrait of a woman from the waist up, depicted in a slightly turned position looking to her left. She has delicate facial features with a high forehead, a straight nose, full lips, and downward-cast eyes. Her long, wavy, dark hair flows over her shoulders, adorned with a crown of flowers and foliage. She wears a light-colored, flowing garment with loose sleeves and holds a bouquet of flowers. The background is a simple textured oval vignette with the name "Ophelia" inscribed above her head.
